texts.preamble: Rajesh Chhikara vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 19 August, 2025 1 / 16 Digitally signed by Anuradha Anuradha Tiwari Tiwari Date: 2025.08.19 16:13:32 +0530 High Court Of Chhattisgarh At Bilaspur Wppil No. 58 of 2019 Sanjay Rajak versus State Of Chhattisgarh Wppil/63/2019 Order Sheet 19.08.2025
texts.facts: B. Construction of Cattle platform (20x20 m): Provision of cattle platform is included in the O&M estimate and a land parcel is also identified near Hardikala & Pendridih village for further execution of works. The O&M Contractor has now initiated the platform construction work in Pendridih village. Additional construction of cattle sheds is also scheduled in Ratanpur and Belmundi village on state government land adjacent to the Bilaspur Pathrapali section of NH 130. The NHAI is collaborating with the district administration and the revenue department, and construction will commence once the land is made available by the state authorities. The cattle sheds will subsequently be transferred to the state authorities for their operation C. Tender has been called for installation of Bamboo fencing in 7350m length on Simga- Bilaspur section of NH 130/49 to control cattle menace by restricting entry of stray cattle on the Highway. Copy of Tender Details for Installation of Bahu-Bali Bamboo fence (Suraksha Kavach) at 0.5m from the edge of Earthen Shoulder with main intention of controlling the entry of cattle from adjacent fields into NH- RoW in 7350 m in Simga-Bilaspur section-Pkg1 and section-Pkg3 are collectively filed herewith as ANNEXURE A. D. That the Toll Plaza team are instructed to make regular announcement and distribute leaflets wherein the road users crossing the toll plaza will be informed for being cautious while travelling on highway & beware from cattle menace. Copy of the photographs wherein the Toll Plaza team are distributing leaflets to the vehicles are filed herewith as ANNEXURE B. E. Additional cautionary Sign boards will be installed for alarming the road users regarding cattle menace on highways. Proposal sent for approval of Competent Authority. F. Labours are being deployed on each identified cattle prone & critical locations in day time & a team of labours are deployed with RPV for removal of cattle menace from highways in night time. Copy of the photographs showing the labours removing cattles from the road are filed herewith as ANNEXURE C. G. Regular Announcements through RPV (Route Patrolling vehicle) & messages on VMS (Variable Message signboards) installed in NH section is being made for alarming road users regarding cattle menace on highways during monsoon season. H. Conducting awareness campaign among nearby villages identified from where cattle enter on Highway were being regularly made in order to curb cattle menace on highways. I. Providing reflective neck belts for cattle on highways to enhance visibility for road users in the event that the cattle wander onto the roadway at night. Copy of the photographs wherein the Toll Plaza team are tying neck belts on cattle are filed herewith as ANNEXURE D. J. Installation of street lights on the cattle identified locations has commenced in Hirri/Hardi and will get completed for other locations in near future.
